title: The Keath House

services.name: Cooking class
services.desc: The Manheim Historical Society is offering a hearth cooking class for adults (ages 16+) at the Keath House! Sign up for this delicious learning opportunity! The hearth cooking class for those 16 & older, will be held at the Keath House from 9:30 AM to 1:00 PM on Saturday, Sept. 19, 2026. The menu for the class will be chicken corn noodle soup, cornbread with butter, & apple cobbler. Wear jeans & closed-toe shoes. Cost is $30.00 per person. Registration deadline is Friday, September 11, 2025. Registrations must be received by that date. Proceeds benefit the Manheim Historical Society. You may register by submitting your name (and the names of any other people for whom you are registering)
